sum: Terra Innovatum Global N.V., a nuclear energy technology company, develops micro-modular nuclear reactors to deliver power solutions. The company offers SOLO, a micro-modular nuclear reactor which generates 1 megawatt electric of baseload power through a gas-cooled system utilizing commercially available low enriched uranium. It serves various industries including cement production, food processing, paper mills, chemical plants, pharmaceutical facilities, and mining operations. Terra Innovatum Global N.V. was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Lucca, Italy.
ceo: Mr. Alessandro  Petruzzi Ph.D. (Co-Founder, CEO & Executive Director)
